# Alperler Auto

Canonical site: https://alperrentacar.online/
Language: Turkish
Primary region: Yüksekova, Hakkari, Türkiye

Alperler Auto is an automotive and travel business website focused on vehicle rental, vehicle sales, local tours, campaigns, branch information, and practical travel and driving content.

## Canonical public sections
- Vehicle rentals: https://alperrentacar.online/fleet
- Vehicles for sale: https://alperrentacar.online/sales
- Tours: https://alperrentacar.online/tours
- Campaigns: https://alperrentacar.online/campaigns
- Branches: https://alperrentacar.online/branches
- Travel and automotive articles: https://alperrentacar.online/blog
- About: https://alperrentacar.online/about
- Contact: https://alperrentacar.online/contact
- FAQ: https://alperrentacar.online/faq

## Source of truth
Public vehicle, tour, blog, campaign, branch, navigation, homepage, footer, and business-profile content is managed from the production database and administration panel. Detail URLs in the XML sitemap are generated from currently published records.

## Crawling guidance
Use the canonical URLs and https://alperrentacar.online/sitemap.xml for discoverable public pages. Do not treat /admin, /branch-portal, /track-car, /booking-checkout, or /api as public content sources.
